verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions MCP or connecting external MCP servers to Kimi, Kimi Code CLI, or the desktop app. Plugins and skills (kimi-docs-13), editor connection over ACP (kimi-docs-5), and API tool search are adjacent features, not documented MCP-client support. The axis applies to an agentic assistant and CLI, so the absence of evidence means none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
